 4 weather alerts in effect Weather Extra: Storms on both coasts 
 Long dry spell into even thru next week 
 Fall foliage forecast (WTVG) By Tony Cavalier Published : Oct. 21, 2026 at 8:28 PM EDT | Updated : 30 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HUNTINGTON, W.Va. (WSAZ) -Now that the fall dry season has arrived, it does not appear to be ready to wear its self out anytime soon! The pattern is set in stone at least for another 6-7 days and perhaps even beyond All Hallows Eve. So fans of sunny days with lots of autumn color and clear, crisp nights, you are in for a treat! Arguably the nicest weather of 2026 has clocked in for an extended vacation!
